testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the detached drawing tab context menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:221:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the detached drawing tab context menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open ✔ And the user drags its tab into the workspace to detach it into a separate window ✔ And the drawing has a document tab in that window ✔ When the user opens the detached drawing tab context menu ✔ Then the menu offers Close, Close Tabs, Close All, Save and Properties ✔ And it displays shortcuts for Close and Save ✔ When the user dismisses the menu ✔ Then the drawing remains open in its separate window
